key.name: publication-permission
key.summary: Allow mouse-selection publication for this desktop account
key.description: Allow explicitly enrolled RUWAC connections to publish text for a deliberate middle-click paste in this unlocked GNOME desktop. This grants account-wide permission to eligible processes running as your user. It does not grant clipboard reading. Disabling revokes current registrations; re-enabling requires a new registration. Every explicit permission action writes a fresh generation with its enabled state in one atomic value. Connection consent is separate.
